protocol.declaration: Prepared before freezing or measuring the new source; seal this file in packet-manifest.json before launch.
protocol.scope: LFM2 DSpark PR1394 latest review only; original qualification plus separate variability evidence
protocol.timing_relationship: The complete original full matrix runs once before A/A. A/A starts at the next phase boundary, after identity and lock checks only. No intentional cooldown, conditioning, warmup beyond original per-scenario/per-cell warmups, clock manipulation, retry or outcome-based reordering. Correctness phases follow A/A irrespective of original performance exit 3.

full_matrix.exit_3: Original performance failure, always retained as failure; does not abort later required phases.

aa.label: PREDECLARED_PLAIN_VERSUS_PLAIN_VARIABILITY_ONLY
aa.rotation_note: Exactly three fixed rotations. With two arms and three rotations, first-launch counts are necessarily 2:1; do not claim position-balanced design.
aa.seed_rule: Original seeds_for: seed 1234 for every greedy stream; 1234+i for sampled stream i.
aa.cell_order: Within each launch: code then chat; within prompt greedy T0 then sampled T1; within scenario widths 1,4,8,16.
aa.warmup_and_oracle_order: Call the unmodified original scenario API: one width-1 16-token scenario warmup; each distinct seed's 512-token solo then draft:false oracle; then for each width one 16-token warmup followed immediately by its 512-token measured cell. No other requests or warmups.
aa.oracle_note: draft:false is used only for the original serial oracle. Both measured arms retain the same normal cheap-copy behavior, no copies-disabled flags or environment overrides.
aa.analysis: Keep every raw request/cell/event/metadata record; compare token/output hashes in both arms and all reps; report each prompt/temperature/width arm's three values, median and min/max, B-A median delta and percentage, each rotation's paired delta and observed delta ranges. No speed acceptance threshold and no tolerance/noise-floor waiver. Never change the original full-matrix verdict.

correctness.implementation: Byte-identical original functional wrapper and source qualification.py, with original eight public prompts; cache/resume/fresh equality, 6-stream 60s and 16-stream 90s cancellation stress, sampled widths 1/4/8/16.
correctness.long_scope: One unchanged original qualification.py long invocation, serving BF16 then original native references; no new long variants.

invariants.model_stdout: Always remote regular files, never SSH or collector pipes
invariants.collector_loss: Detached session and file-backed supervisor/phase/server logs continue without a collector. A lost collector does not authorize a relaunch.
